attack_families.description: Distributed denial-of-service activity intended to make a service, system, or network resource unavailable by overwhelming it with network traffic or requests.
indicators: Large increase in packet or flow rates
investigation: Examine packet and flow rates
Identify unusual source and destination patterns
Check whether multiple sources are targeting the same service
Compare traffic characteristics with normal baseline behavior
mitigation: Block or filter malicious traffic sources

attack_families.description: Denial-of-service activity that attempts to make a system or service unavailable by exhausting or disrupting its resources.
investigation: Analyze traffic volume and flow characteristics
Identify targeted services or hosts
Compare current traffic against normal behavior
Investigate unusual request patterns

attack_families.description: An attack in which an adversary attempts to gain access to accounts, systems, or services by repeatedly trying possible credentials.
indicators: Repeated attempts against an account or service
investigation: Examine authentication failure patterns
Identify source addresses generating repeated attempts
Check targeted accounts or services
Determine whether successful authentication followed repeated failures
mitigation: Implement account lockout or access controls

attack_families.description: Network reconnaissance activity in which an adversary probes systems or services to identify available network services and ports.
investigation: Identify the scanning source
Examine the number of destination ports contacted
Examine the number of hosts contacted
Determine whether the activity precedes other suspicious behavior
mitigation: Use network monitoring and filtering controls

attack_families.description: Malicious activity associated with compromised systems that may be remotely controlled and used to perform coordinated actions.
indicators: Repeated communication with suspicious external systems
Similar traffic patterns across multiple systems
investigation: Identify suspicious external communication
Examine repeated communication patterns
Check whether multiple hosts exhibit similar behavior
Investigate affected hosts for signs of compromise

sources.name: MITRE ATT&CK
sources.reference: Cyber threat behavior and technique documentation

attack_families.description: Malicious activity targeting web applications, including attempts to exploit application functionality or obtain unauthorized access.
investigation: Examine HTTP request patterns
Identify suspicious parameters and endpoints
Correlate requests with application logs
Determine whether exploitation or unauthorized access occurred

attack_families.description: Network activity that does not exhibit characteristics associated with the attack families represented in the dataset.
investigation: Verify that the traffic is consistent with expected network behavior
Check for contextual information if the activity is unusual
